FN-ZTNYRKK-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 27
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Donnie Chesteen
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 02/14/2024
Senate Bill 27 as introduced would, beginning in fiscal year 2025, expand the list of additional
items that constitute election expenses that would be reimbursable to counties, which would
increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an undetermined amount dependent on the
extent to which counties currently: (1) use electronic poll books and electronic voting machines
and, at a minimum, are required to provide maintenance and update equipment and software; (2)
pay costs to rent facilities as polling places; and (3) provide training and associated travel
expenses for absentee election managers.

FN-ZTNYRKK-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 27
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Donnie Chesteen
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/19/2024
REVISED
Senate Bill 27 as introduced would, beginning fiscal year 2025, expand the list of items that
constitute election expenses that would be reimbursable to counties which would increase the
obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated total of $2,265,594 per election cycle, or
half this amount if the election includes both state and county offices, based on the cost of the
following election expenses incurred by counties, as provided by the Association of County
Commissions of Alabama: (1) $1,175,020 for the maintenance and software updates of
electronic poll books; (2) $650,000 for the maintenance and software updates of electronic
voting machines; (3) $396,000 for the renting of facilities used as polling places; (4) $32,849 for
the training of election officials; and (5) an undetermined amount dependent on the travel
expenses incurred by appointed absentee election managers.
